messages:
Alice M.: Heads up — planning to cut release/1.18 this Friday 11:00 PT. Need owners for branch creation, changelog, and backports.
Ben K.: I can create the branch and push the initial tag. Will run the cut script Thu morning unless someone objects.
Carla S.: I can own the CHANGELOG.md entries and assemble release notes, but I’ll need a couple of PR summaries from authors.
David R.: QA will do a smoke run on the release branch. Can someone mark which PRs should be included for testing (label `backport-candidate` or put the branch in the PR title)?
Ben K.: Plan: create branch Thu 09:00 PT. Command I’ll use: `./scripts/cut_release.sh --branch release/1.18 --from main`. I’ll also open a tracking PR referencing the cut.
Carla S.: Sweet. Request from docs: please include a one-sentence user-facing summary in PR descriptions so I can paste into notes.
Alice M.: Backport policy reminder — only bug fixes and docs that are user-impacting after cutoff. No behavior-changing API additions as backports. If a backport touches public API, must get explicit sign-off from the API owner @Mikey L.
Mikey L.: Acknowledge. I’ll review any API-related backport requests; please @mention me and include the rationale.
David R.: Also, post-cutoff rule: after Fri 11:00 PT only security/critical regressions with 2 approvers + test evidence. We’ll gate merges with `release/1.18` protected branch rules.
Ben K.: Small operational ask — should we update `backport.yaml` to include the new branch name now or after the cut? I can do it in a follow-up PR.
Carla S.: Please add it now so labels and bots can pick up candidates early. Saves time on Thu.
Alice M.: Good call. Ben, add a `changelog/owner=carla` label to the tracking PR so I know notes are covered.
Ben K.: Will do. Also planning a 30m cutover sync Fri 10:30 PT to walk through the checklist and smoke plan.
David R.: I’ll create the calendar invite and attach the test checklist.
Carla S.: Quick note on cherry-picks: when you create a backport PR, put `[backport release/1.18]` in the title and include the original PR link. If conflicts are non-trivial, ping the author for context.
Alice M.: Final reminder — cutoff Fri 11:00 PT. After that only the exceptions we mentioned. Please self-assign tasks in the release board and add any known risky PRs to the board column `Needs backport triage`. :thumbsup:
release-bot: Branch creation scheduled: release/1.18 pending (simulated).
Ben K.: Branch created locally and pushed: `release/1.18` -> commit `abc1234`. Opening tracking PR now.
Carla S.: Thanks — I’ll start drafting notes and will post a PR with the assembled changelog later today. :party:
